messages:
Noah V: Quick flag on PR #10012 - worked example in the pricing doc mixes list prices and reserved discounts and readers might think generation+embeddings are a single SKU.
Priya K: Can you paste the snippet so we can fix it quickly?
Noah V: Current block: 
```
Request: generate 600 tokens + 2 embeddings
Doc math: 600 * $0.00002 = $0.01200 + 2 * $0.0004 = $0.0008 -> Total $0.0128
```
This omits that Dedicated reserved discounts apply to generation only and that token rounding is per-request.
Ava (docs): Proposed replacement (concise, clear): 
```
Illustrative example (not a quote):
Request: generate 600 tokens + 2 embeddings
List price: generation = 600 * $0.00002 = $0.01200
List price: embeddings = 2 * $0.00040 = $0.00080
List subtotal = $0.01280
Reserved discount (generation only, example 10%): generation discounted = $0.01200 * 0.9 = $0.01080
Total after discount = $0.01080 + $0.00080 = $0.01160 (~$0.0116)
Notes: tokens are rounded per request; embedding billing can be aggregated by billing window. See metering glossary for definitions.
```
Priya K: Add a tiny SDK snippet and a 3-row legend (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) so readers map requests -> meter events. Also include a Console screenshot callout showing generation vs embeddings split.
Noah V: Added Node SDK sample and labeled the discount as "illustrative (10%)" in the PR. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/10012
BillingBot: CI status - docs/build: succeeded (https://ci.internal.redwood/docs/10012) :white_check_mark:
Sam P: LGTM. Ava, can you merge and backport the note to the billing FAQ?
Ava (docs): Will do after CI. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
